title: Flydubai flight incident: Netanyahu says Israel preparing for other ‘potential threats’
summary_full: A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv experienced a serious incident that required an emergency landing. Following a cockpit altercation, one pilot was arrested and investigated by Saudi authorities. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the situation was managed and the safety of passengers was prioritized. Warplanes were scrambled in response to potential hijacking fears but were later stood down.
